title: Special Multigenerational Rates at Major Tourist Attractions
what_it_is: Special Multigenerational Rates at Major Tourist Attractions

sections.label: Attraction and sports concessions
sections.summary: Attractions offer tiered pricing and family promotions, NHB museums give Singaporeans free permanent gallery entry, and ActiveSG and public sports facilities grant concessionary rates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Examples of attractions that offer such tiered pricing include the Singapore Zoo and Singapore Science Centre.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Some attractions, such as the Art Science Museum, have special promotions for those who visit as a family.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: We will encourage attractions to continue to develop ways to promote intergenerational bonding among Singaporean families.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The museums run by the National Heritage Board (NHB), including the National Museum of Singapore (NMS) and Asian Civilisations Museum (ACM) already offer free entry to Singaporeans for the permanent galleries.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The National Heritage Board also organises the annual Singapore Heritage Festival and Singapore Night Festival which have family-friendly activities, such as performances and guided tours.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: In the heartlands, ActiveSG members who are below the age of 18 and those 55 years and above enjoy special rates for entry to ActiveSG gyms and swimming complexes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Concessionary rates are also granted to senior citizens and their accompanying immediate family members using selected public sports facilities during specified hours on weekdays.

sections.label: Families for Life picnics
sections.summary: The Families for Life Council organises regular picnics at heartland parks to encourage intergenerational family bonding.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The Families for Life Council also organises regular picnics at these and other heartland parks to encourage intergenerational family bonding.
